description.value: At 4th level, a paladin is immune to any effect that would force her reroll a die against her will or roll twice and take the lower result. Whenever an ally within 10 feet of her would reroll a die against her will, she can roll twice and take the higher result. Whenever an ally within 10 feet would be forced to roll twice and take the lower result, she can instead roll three times and take the second-lowest result. This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious.
